project_title: Licensed Electrical PE (NV) Needed to Review & Stamp Electrical As‑Built Drawings

project_metadata.job_title: Licensed Electrical PE (NV) Needed to Review & Stamp Electrical As‑Built Drawings
project_metadata.job_description:
We are seeking a Licensed Electrical Professional Engineer (PE) to review and stamp the electrical as‑built drawings for a completed project at a Healthcare System (North Las Vegas, NV).

We need an Electrical PE to provide discipline‑specific concurrence for the electrical modifications.

This is a small‑scope, low‑complexity electrical job.
No load calculations, no panel upgrades, and no redesign are required.

What We Need From You
Review the electrical as‑built sheets (PDF)
Provide PE stamp + signature on the electrical sheets

milestones._note: milestone_description and submission_feedback are masked by a Snowflake data policy under current role access; submission matched via latest-submission-per-milestone heuristic, not event-log pairing

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hello [CLIENT_NAME_001], I couldn’t see any file if one was attached.
Please resend it so I can provide an accurate quote.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I’ll review it and respond within a few minutes.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Yes, I can assist with stamping your project.
Do you have a target timeframe or budget?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Given how simple the project is, I expect the review and stamp to be completed in 2 business days. Since this is a very simple change, I was hoping to have it stamped for \$100. Please let me know. Thanks

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Yes, the project is simple, but the document contains 36 pages, so that quote may be too low.
Could we agree on $200-250 with completion within the next 24-36 hours?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Hello [CLIENT_NAME_001], are you still with me?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Although the 36 pages may look daunting, you do not actually need to review all of them. I initially thought the same, but the work only involves reviewing the minor modifications identified in the word file. I am a mechanical PE for this change, and my scope was reduced to the attached file \(only the highlighted portion\). The situation is the same for electrical. If it works for you, let’s settle on \$150, and I will notify the client. Please advise.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okayyy, let's procced

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Please send a contract so that we can begin.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thanks. I’ll notify the client and initiate the offer as soon as I receive confirmation.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Alright

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Additionally, could you let me know whether you can support me with the attached project? Please provide your price and timeline for permit-ready Mechanical, Plumbing and Electrical drawings with an electrical PE stamp \(I will handle the Mechanical and Plumbing stamp\).

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Yes, I can assist with that too.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: what is your budget?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Please provide a reasonable quote, and I’ll check whether it fits the client’s budget.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Would $300 work?
Also, when will the project be ready to kickoff?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: For this one, the client wants to know whether you require redline drawings or can stamp it using the provided description file explaining what changed.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: In my opinion, the redlined drawing is the best document to stamp because it shows what was completed in response to the previous comment.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Okay, I’ll ask the client about that. To confirm, this will include permit-ready Mechanical, Plumbing and Electrical drawings with all required load calculations \(T 24 is not needed, but HvAC sizing calculations are\), correct? Could you also provide your California electrical PE license number? The project should kick off soon \(within no more than two weeks\).

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: My understanding was that the scope only covered review and stamping. Will I also be responsible for providing additional drawings and calculations?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Understood. What if the client supplies pictures of the changes that align with the description? If you still require redlines, I will request them; I just wanted to determine the minimum information needed to kickoff the project.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
At minimum, I would normally require the following to kick off the project:
The written scope of work, which has already been provided
Photos showing each modified area
The room numbers connected to each change
Any sketches, screenshots, or informal markups indicating the approximate work locations

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Name: ADLER J ROBERT
License Number: 16119
Credential: Electrical PE

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Apologies for the delayed reply. You would create the drawings and stamp the electrical drawings \(I will stamp the mechanical drawings\). You would also perform whatever calculations are required to produce the drawings \(please let me know whether that is within your competence\). This includes Manual. J, Manual S,,Manual D as applicable.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Given this scope, what price and timeline would you propose?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Thank you for clarifying. Yes, this scope is within my capabilities. My estimated fee for the electrical permit drawings, PE stamp, necessary electrical calculations, and Manual J/S/D calculations as applicable would be $5,000–$8,000. The estimated turnaround is approximately 3–4 weeks, provided that the architectural background files are complete and permit-ready.

This is an extensive scope.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hmm, that seems like a lot. Just out of curiosity, have you completed projects of a similar size, and do clients typically pay this amount? I’m asking because I don’t want to accept a job that is too large and cannot be delivered, while also wanting to ensure that the price I request is not completely outside the normal range. Thanks for your help, Abigail.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Yes, I’ve handled projects with comparable size and complexity, and this fee range is fairly standard when calculations, permit drawings, and PE stamping are included. Your pricing does not appear to be outside the market. The important point is to ensure you are comfortable with the scope and can confidently support the project throughout permitting.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Understood. I’ll present this pricing to the client and update you with their feedback. Thanks.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: My Pleasure
